?

Nehemiah 2:18a MSG
I told them how God was supporting me and how the king was backing me up. ?

?You will have stories to tell today, of how God backed you up.
?You will have testimonies to share today of how God helped you

?You will enjoy unprecedented favour with God and with man today. Everywhere you go today, will be laden with blessings with your name on it in Jesus name
